entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

The issue? The issue is they're garbage! I took them for one ride, just one! I set up the cleats perfectly, and after ten miles I have the worst blisters of my life. These things are torture devices, not shoes!

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can see you received the order just five days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for you.

Don't give me the runaround with 'policy'. I want a refund, and I want it now. This is ridiculous. If you can't do it, put your manager on the phone. I'm already drafting a one-star review for your website.

I understand your urgency, sir, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you directly. Just one moment... Okay, I've reviewed your order and our return information. The cycling shoes fall under our standard 90-day policy, so you are well within the window.

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the shoes, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. About time. So the email is on its way?
It should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
